rules.statement: The plaintiff's claim to the incumbency of Tissamaharama temple is barred by prescription due to his failure to establish that Dhammananda had disrobed himself and because he was not the senior pupil of Medankara.
rules.supporting_quote: It follows from the fact that Dhammananda was not the senior pupil of Medankara that plaintiff cannot claim the incumbency as his pupillary successor. Whatever rights he may have-I confess I cannot say what they are-did not depend on Dhammananda ceasing to be a priest. His cause of action is therefore barred by the lapse of three years after the defendant became incumbent in January or February, 1931.
